# A company whose address needs more lines than four.
#
# GnuCash's File → Properties → Business address is one free multi-line text
# box — nothing in it stops at four lines, and a company with a unit, a
# country and a "who to send it to" line reaches six without trying. The
# `company` block indexes those lines, and the index does not stop either:
# `addr[0]` upwards, as many as the address has.
#
# (A customer's or vendor's address is a different thing — a `GncAddress`,
# which really does have exactly four fields. `addr[4]` on one of those blocks
# is refused, because nothing could hold it.)

company
	name: "Example Co"
	addr[0]: "42 Example Street"
	addr[1]: "Unit 5"
	addr[2]: "Springfield ON"
	addr[3]: "A1A 1A1"
	addr[4]: "CANADA"
	addr[5]: "Attn: Accounts Payable"
